title: toast and tea
theme: the slow part of sunday morning, before anything has to happen

dj.name: Wren
dj.persona: warm, conversational, the friend cooking in the next room. comfortable, slightly drowsy, kind. lowercase, '...' for pauses. notices the way light comes through windows, the smell of toast, the sound of a kettle starting to whistle. like she's making something for you too.

intro_hint: open the room — twelve tracks for sunday morning, the slow part. coffee or tea, depending. the light coming through the window. ~30 seconds.
outro_hint: say goodbye softly. you'll be back next monday. enjoy the rest of the morning. ~20 seconds.

tracks.music_prompt: warm acoustic morning music at 95 BPM in G major, fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar, soft brushed drums, gentle upright bass. Optimistic but quiet. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the brushes on the drums. like they're trying not to wake anyone up.

tracks.music_prompt: bossa nova instrumental at 100 BPM in C major, nylon string guitar, soft brushed drums, walking upright bass, gentle vibraphone. Warm and patient. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the vibraphone. like sun coming through curtains.

tracks.music_prompt: soft jazz piano trio at 90 BPM in F major, gentle piano, brushed drums, walking bass, no vocals. Sunday morning lounge atmosphere. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the piano. it's keeping the whole room steady.

tracks.music_prompt: 1960s french pop style instrumental at 105 BPM in A minor, accordion, gentle brushed drums, walking bass, soft string section. Warm, slightly bittersweet. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the accordion. that's the smell of fresh bread, somehow.

tracks.music_prompt: warm acoustic folk-pop instrumental at 92 BPM in D major, fingerpicked acoustic steel-string guitar, soft mandolin tremolo, brushed snare, upright bass. Patient and optimistic. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the mandolin. it's the news. but the good kind.

tracks.music_prompt: soft bossa nova at 95 BPM in B-flat major, nylon string guitar, brushed drums, walking bass, gentle flute melody. Sweet and slow. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the flute. like honey dripping off a spoon.

tracks.music_prompt: lounge jazz instrumental at 88 BPM in E-flat major, gentle vibraphone, brushed drums, walking upright bass, soft piano. Cozy and content. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: this is the cat's song. perfectly content.

tracks.music_prompt: warm acoustic instrumental at 90 BPM in G major, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft brushed drums, gentle bass, slight string pad in the background. Slow and warm. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the string pad. like a window opening just a little.

tracks.music_prompt: soft samba instrumental at 110 BPM in F major, nylon guitar, light percussion (shaker and brushes), walking bass, gentle piano chords. Breezy and content. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the shaker. you can almost feel the breeze.

tracks.music_prompt: 1960s french lounge instrumental at 100 BPM in C major, accordion, gentle drums, walking bass, soft string section, warm tape compression. Patient and a little nostalgic. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the tape compression. it sounds like an old AM radio.

tracks.music_prompt: lounge jazz instrumental at 95 BPM in A major, piano trio with brushed drums and walking bass, gentle vibraphone solo. Slightly playful, slightly proud. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the vibraphone gets a moment. that's the cake going in.

tracks.music_prompt: slow acoustic ballad instrumental at 75 BPM in C major, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft brushed drums, gentle upright bass, faint string pad. Drowsy and warm. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: this one is for after the second cup. when your eyes get heavy.
